name: Owlbear

actions.name: Claws
actions.effect: On a critical hit, the target bleeds for 1d6 at the start of each turn until healed.

actions.name: Ferocious Charge
actions.effect: The Owlbear charges up to 12m and attacks. Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone and grappled.

reactions.name: Savage Retaliation
reactions.effect: When reduced below half HP, the Owlbear can immediately make a Claws attack against an adjacent enemy.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: +2d6 to perception checks. Cannot be surprised.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a free action, the Owlbear can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

lore: Owlbears are ferocious predators with the body of a bear and the head of an owl. They are fiercely territorial, attacking anything that enters their domain with relentless aggression. Some believe they were created by a mad wizard's experiment.
